## What's Changed

- Add bounded Metrics Explore for Prometheus and VictoriaMetrics, including metric discovery and range charts.
- Persist Logs/Metrics mode per Data View, migrate existing metric views, and filter Explore selectors by mode.
- Align Metrics time controls with Logs and preserve mode across PostgreSQL and filesystem storage.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.5.4...0.5.5-rc
